config.llm_guardian.disabled_desc: Enable to add an LLM-based security layer that evaluates tool calls before execution. Uses a fast, cheap model to detect suspicious operations. Falls back to the main LLM if no provider is selected.
config.llm_guardian.provider_desc: Select a provider for the Guardian LLM. A fast, cheap model (e.g. Gemini Flash, GPT-4o-mini, local 3B) is recommended for sub-second decisions.
config.llm_guardian.level_desc: Controls which tool calls are sent to the Guardian for review. Higher levels check more operations but cost more tokens.
config.llm_guardian.level_low: Low — Only high-risk tools (shell, sudo, python)
config.llm_guardian.failsafe_desc: What happens when the Guardian LLM is unavailable or returns an error (timeout, rate limit, etc.).
config.llm_guardian.failsafe_quarantine: Quarantine — Allow but log and warn
config.llm_guardian.perf_desc: Cache and rate limiting settings to control costs and latency.
config.llm_guardian.overrides_desc: Override the protection level for specific tools. Useful to always check dangerous tools or skip safe ones.
config.llm_guardian.clarification_desc: When enabled, the agent can provide a justification if a tool call is blocked. The Guardian re-evaluates the request once with the justification before making a final decision.
config.llm_guardian.scan_desc: Use the Guardian LLM to scan incoming content (emails, webhooks) for prompt injection, phishing, and social engineering attacks — beyond the built-in regex patterns.
config.llm_guardian.enabled_help: A second, fast model reviews risky tool calls before they run. Each check costs tokens and a little time.
config.llm_guardian.provider_help: Provider of the reviewing model. Without a selection the main LLM is used. A fast, cheap model is enough.
config.llm_guardian.level_help: Decides which tool calls are reviewed. Higher levels check more but cost more tokens. You can set individual tools differently below.
config.llm_guardian.failsafe_help: Behavior when the review itself fails (timeout, rate limit). Block is the safest, Allow skips the check entirely.
config.llm_guardian.cache_ttl_help: Seconds a review result is reused for the same call (0 = no cache, default 300).
config.llm_guardian.rate_limit_help: Upper limit of reviews per minute to cap costs (default 60).
config.llm_guardian.clarification_help: The agent may justify a blocked call and the Guardian reviews it one more time. This can lead to more approvals.
config.llm_guardian.scan_emails_help: Also scans incoming emails with the reviewing model for prompt injection and phishing. Every email uses tokens.
config.llm_guardian.scan_documents_help: Also scans incoming webhook payloads with the reviewing model for prompt injection. Every call uses tokens.
config.llm_guardian.override_add_help: Pick a tool and a level that should apply instead of the default level, then add it with +.
